facts.statement: Free Realms held annual holiday celebrations that bring the community together.
facts.quote: Annual holiday celebrations that bring the gaming community together

article_summaries.title: Happy Birthday Free Realms Video!
article_summaries.summary: SOE's anniversary post marks two years since Free Realms launched on PC (April 28, 2009) and reports over 17 million registered users across PC, Mac and PlayStation 3. It lists the year's updates: new houses and lots, new rides, farming, annual holiday events, the Treasure Wars card game, and famous guest visitors. The post gives no detailed mechanics, prices or dates for these features.
